title: GetInboundOrderDetail
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Use this API to get the Inbound Order Detail
html:
Request Address

GET/fbl/inbound_order_detail/get
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
inbound_order_noStringYesInbound ouder number
marketplaceStringYesEnum Value:LAZADA_VN,LAZADA_SG,LAZADA_MY, LAZADA_ID,LAZADA_PH,LAZADA_TH

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
dataObjectYesOrder detail
  reservation_statusStringNoReservationStatus: PENDING_RESERVATION_ORDER_CREATE | RESERVATION_ORDER_CREATED | RESERVED |ARRIVED. PENDING_RESERVATION_ORDER_CREATE
  reservation_orderStringNoReservation Order number
  seller_cityStringNoSeller's city
  seller_addressStringNoSeller's address
  seller_postcodeStringNoSeller's postcode
  seller_countryStringNoSeller's country
  seller_contactStringNoSeller's contact for this order
  seller_mobileStringNoSeller's mobile for this order
  fulfillment_order_numberStringNoFulfillment order number
  inbound_warehouse_codeStringNoInbound warehouse code
  inbound_timeStringYesActually inbound time
  skusObject[]YesSku list
    item_inbounded_expiredStringNoItem Inbounded-Expired
    seller_skuString[]YesSeller Sku Id List
    item_inbounded_goodNumberYesItems Inbounded-Good
    serial_number_flagBooleanYesSerial Number Flag
    sku_statusStringYesSku status
    item_inbounded_damagedNumberYesItem Inbounded-Damaged
    fulfillment_sku_nameStringYesFulfillment sku name
    requested_quantityNumberYesRequested quantity
    shelf_life_flagBooleanYesShelf Life Flag
    barcodesString[]YesSku barcode list
    fulfillment_skuStringYesFulfillment sku
    commentsStringNoItem comment
  commentsStringYesOrder comment
  io_numberStringYesInbound order number
  estimate_timeStringYesEstimate inbound time
  marketplaceStringYesmarketplace
  delivery_typeStringYesSeller drop off to warehouse Lazada Pickup
  created_atStringYesOrder create time
  inbound_warehouseStringYesInbound warehouse name
  reference_numberStringYesReference number
  updated_atStringYesOrder update time
  io_statusStringYesOrder status: Created|Pending Plan Approval|Pending Approval|Approved|Rejected by Lazada|Operate Inventory|Foc Order Created|Request Accepted|Inbound in Process|Partially|Completely|Cancelled by Seller|Cancelled by Lazada|Cancelled by system|Rejected by Warehouse
  shop_nameStringNoShop name
  io_typeStringNoOrder type, normal|reinbound|New Product Launch|Sellable In Transit
  warehouse_nameStringNoLazada's warehouse name
  warehouse_addressStringNoLazada's warehouse adress
  seller_warehouse_nameStringNoSeller's warehouse name
  need_reservationBooleanNoWhether need inbound reservation, true|false
